name: The Spell-Slinger
tagline: You fight fire with fire magic: a custom-built set of attack spells, a toolkit of rituals, and a wizard council that keeps nosing into your business.
luckSpecial: Each time you spend a Luck point, the official council of wizards starts poking its nose into your business. (Spending Luck can also avoid all harm from one injury.)

moves.intro: Take every basic move plus four Spell-Slinger moves. Tools and Techniques is free; pick three others from the list. Your attack spells are covered separately under Combat Magic.

auto.name: Tools and Techniques
auto.summary: Your combat magic depends on four things: consumables, foci, gestures and incantations. Cross one off; you rely on the other three. Consumables are powders, oils and similar supplies, some used up with each cast; lacking them, casting costs you 1-harm ignore-armour. Foci are wands, staves and similar props; lacking them, your combat magic deals one point less harm. Gestures are hand movements; while restrained, you take -1 ongoing to combat magic. Incantations are words in an arcane language; if you cast combat magic silently, you have to act under pressure to keep your mind from scrambling.

choices.name: Advanced Arcane Training
choices.summary: With two of your remaining three tools and techniques in hand, you can do without the third.

choices.name: Arcane Reputation
choices.summary: Choose three major groups or organizations from the supernatural scene (friendlier monsters can count). They know your reputation and respect your power. Humans among them give you a bonus of +1 forward when manipulated by you; monsters among them can be manipulated like humans, but with no bonus.

choices.name: Could've Been Worse
choices.summary: If your use magic roll is a miss, you can pick one of these instead of the magic getting out of control. Fizzle: the spell's prep and materials are wasted, and redoing it takes twice the prep time. This Is Gonna Suck: the spell works, but every listed glitch happens except one, which you choose to dodge.

choices.name: Enchanted Clothing
choices.summary: Choose a piece of ordinary clothing. It is enchanted but looks the same. Harm from anything reaching you through that garment is reduced by 1.

choices.name: Forensic Divination
choices.summary: After a successful investigate a mystery roll, you get a bonus question: "What magic was done here?"

choices.name: Go Big or Go Home
choices.summary: Use magic rolls you make to meet the requirements of Big Magic get +1 ongoing.

choices.name: Not My Fault
choices.summary: Dealing with the fallout from your own spells gives you +1 to act under pressure.

choices.name: Practitioner
choices.summary: Pick two of the effects open to you under use magic. Each time you choose one of those two, add +1 to the use magic roll.

choices.name: Shield Spell
choices.summary: Protecting someone gives you 2-armour against harm passed on to you. It does not stack with other armour you may have.

choices.name: Third Eye
choices.summary: Your third eye can open briefly while you read a bad situation, giving extra information: any roll of 7 or more earns +1 hold, and you can see invisible things. After a miss you can still take 1 hold, but you are exposed to supernatural danger, since raw hidden reality is hard on the mind.

gear.title: Backup weapon
gear.intro: You do not need much beyond the foci or consumables that power your magic, but it is good to carry a backup. Pick one.

extras.title: Tools and Techniques: cross one off
extras.intro: Cross off one of these four; you will need the other three. (You can cross off another one later as an advanced improvement.)

options.label: Consumables
options.detail: Without supplies on hand when you cast, you take 1-harm ignore-armour.

options.label: Foci
options.detail: Missing your props means your combat magic deals 1 less harm.

options.label: Gestures
options.detail: While you are restrained, combat magic takes -1 ongoing.

options.label: Incantations
options.detail: Casting in silence means you must act under pressure or your thoughts get scrambled.

extras.title: Combat magic: bases
extras.intro: These are your attack spells. Casting them to kick some ass uses +Weird in place of +Tough, though the Keeper may call for act under pressure to cast cleanly. You get three combat magic picks in all, at least one of them a base. A spell is one base plus any effects you own.

options.label: Blast
options.detail: Harm 2; tags: magic, close, obvious, loud.

options.label: Ball
options.detail: Harm 1; tags: magic, area, close, obvious, loud.

options.label: Missile
options.detail: Harm 1; tags: magic, far, obvious, loud.

options.label: Wall
options.detail: Harm 1; 1-armour; tags: magic, barrier, close, obvious, loud.

extras.title: Combat magic: effects
extras.intro: Any picks left over from your three combat magic choices (after at least one base) go on effects. You can add any effect to any of your bases.

options.label: Fire
options.detail: Gives a base +2 harm and the fire tag. A 10+ on the combat magic roll keeps the fire from spreading.

options.label: Force or Wind
options.detail: Gives a base +1 harm and the forceful tag, or a wall +1 armour.

options.label: Lightning or Entropy
options.detail: Gives a base +1 harm and the messy tag.

options.label: Frost or Ice
options.detail: On a wall: adds "-1 harm +2 armour". On other bases: adds "+1 harm restraining".

options.label: Earth
options.detail: Gives a base the forceful and restraining tags.

options.label: Necromantic
options.detail: Gives a base the life-drain tag.

history: They keep you grounded whenever your power gets to you. Ask about the most recent time that happened.
You are related by blood but lost touch for years. Ask how they found their way back to you.
They mentored you in a past life. Ask what they taught you.
You used magic to save them, which is how they first learned monsters exist. Ask them which creature was hunting them.
Your old rivalry became a close friendship. Tell them what the fight was about.
You believed they had died, yet here they are. Ask what supposedly killed them.
You keep drifting together and apart as a couple. Ask what separates you, and tell them what holds you together.
They are a fellow fighter who has stood beside you against the worst threats.
